claim: AWS recommends Kinesis Data Streams for use cases that need ordering of records, for example transferring log data from the application host to the processing or archival host while maintaining the order of log statements.

evidence.quote: We recommend Kinesis Data Streams for use cases with requirements that are similar to the following:
Ordering of records. For example, you want to transfer log data from the application host to the processing/archival host while maintaining the order of log statements.
